name: Yoshizawa Sanae
source:
The proprietress of a hot spring inn and the mother of the main character. 

She worked as an obstetrician/gynecologist and got married at the age of 24. She is a cheerful and amiable woman, but a bit of a miser. 

She also shows the face of a manager who is strict about money.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momofero/product/ringetsu/index.html]official site[/url]]
